Westfield Innovation · S28

Bring a swing.
Not a chair.

The seat is not bolted to anything. It hangs from the arms on four straps — so it swings under you, and rocks while it does it.

Go on

Sit down.
Push off.

Keep your feet on the ground and give it a shove. The straps do the rest.

01 · REACH UNDER THE ARM

Four webbing straps, two a side. That is the whole suspension.

02 · PUSH

It travels forward and back along an arc, and tips as it goes.

03 · LET GO

It settles back to the bottom of the arc. Gravity does that, not a spring.

01 — The category

Every other camp chair bolts the seat down.

01 · QUAD CHAIRS

Fabric pinned to the frame at four corners. The seat is the frame. Nothing moves.

02 · ROCKERS

Runners or spring feet added under a chair that already folds. Motion bolted on below.

03 · THE RESULT

A chair that folds, or a chair that moves. Not both.

This one adds nothing underneath. It hangs the seat from the arms it already has.

02 — The idea

Two frames. One hangs inside the other.

The outer frame folds and stands on the ground. The inner one carries the seat and the back, and it is held only by the webbing — it touches the outer frame nowhere else.

The webbing is the only thing holding it up.

Design, and sample

Same chair.
Two states of done.

LEFT · THE SAMPLE

Built and sat in. 5.6″ of travel on four straps.

RIGHT · THE DESIGN

Cleaner arm, lighter back, 6.6″ of webbing instead of 5.6.

THE JOB

The motion is close. What still has to travel is the shape.

Both hang the same way. Both move.

03 — The suspension

Four straps, and nothing else.

Each one runs from the arm tube down to the base of the seat, two a side. Static webbing, not elastic — the straps set the path, the shock cords under the seat set the ends of it.

All of it sits above the seat.

04 — How it moves

It swings.
And it rocks.

01 · IT SWINGS

Four equal straps carry the seat along an arc, forward and back.

02 · IT ROCKS

The webbing gives and your weight shifts, so it pitches as it travels.

03 · IT COMES BACK

The seat rises 0.7″ at full travel. Gravity brings it down again.

Feet stay on the ground, so you set the tempo.

05 — The travel

5.6 inches.

Front to back, measured at the leading edge of the seat.

Seat 18.9″ wide, 18.5″ off the ground — a full-size adult seat.

06 — And it still

Folds flat.

The suspension does not add a single member below the seat, so the outer frame folds exactly the way it always did. The motion costs nothing in the fold, the pack or the shelf.

Motion above the seat, not hardware beneath it.

07 — Where it goes

Car camp. Tailgate.
Back yard.

It packs down like any other folding chair and sets up the same way. The difference is what happens once you sit down.
